summary.text: Mandy Newton Rosenow is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Dan Gehlbach.
A physician assistant, she says in a Ballotpedia survey that she is focused on water quality, cancer rates and support for schools.

paragraphs.text: Mandy Newton Rosenow graduated from Sioux City North High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Iowa in 1998 and a graduate degree from Des Moines University in 2004.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a fifth-generation Iowan raised in Sioux City who has worked as a physician assistant in family practice, emergency medicine, neurology and community medicine.
She said she and her husband, who served in the U.S. Navy and Marines, have two children.
Newton Rosenow defeated Anne Craven and Erin Helleso in the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
She listed improving water quality monitoring, studying and treating rising cancer rates, and better school resources among her priorities.
